description: The bar chart illustrates performance gain (in percent) for three LVLM models under two training conditions, “Strong Supervision” and “Weak Supervision,” as indicated by the legend at the top (Strong Supervision shown as blue bars with diagonal hatching; Weak Supervision shown as solid light-blue bars). The horizontal axis contains the model categories labeled left to right as GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL, and the vertical axis is labeled “Performance Gain (+%)” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30 with regularly spaced tick marks every 5 units. For GPT-4o, the Strong Supervision bar reaches approximately 24–25%, while the Weak Supervision bar is around 5%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the Strong Supervision bar is about 9–10% and the Weak Supervision bar is about 3–4%. For Qwen2-72B-VL, the Strong Supervision bar is approximately 15% and the Weak Supervision bar is approximately 5%. The bars are presented as paired groups per model (two adjacent bars per category) and do not appear to be sorted by value; no individual bars are specially annotated or otherwise visually emphasized beyond the color/hatching scheme.
